items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Vernelly' as one of the people present ('Fournier, John Young, ... Vernelly, ... and the other singer'), implying the interviewee knew them, but the interviewee does not mention Vernelly by name or describe a specific personal relationship.

ctx.x: -- Vernelly, (unintelligible), and the other singer whose name escapes me at the moment -- it'll come to me. But it was just -- everybody seemed so happy to see you and they asked me to stand up, take a bow, here's Wilbur home. It was a different feeling then. They seemed proud.

That's the way it is. You know, you go away from your hometown and just make a record or two or get a little recognition that somebody read about you and you're a celebrity. I used to think, 'Well, I'm playing the same stuff I was playing (inaudible). Why do you treat me this way now?' You know?
